blocks.p: The station wagon is short a tire. Angel fits one at the pumps, from the *Vehicle* tab of the *World* window.

The *Vehicle* tab opens when you are next to a car. The parts are listed on the left, by section; a part that has to come off before another is listed with the other part under it. Click a part and its card opens on the right: its condition, its type and where the work is done. Under the card, *From your bags and nearby* lists the parts that fit, with their condition and where they are. Pick one and click *Install*, at the foot of the tab.

blocks.p: The front left tire of the wagon is missing. Angel has an old tire in his inventory, at 100 percent condition; the other two kinds of tire are not nearby.

The Vehicle tab opens when you are next to a car.

sticky.text: Fixing the wagon: the Vehicle tab.

blocks.p: While a part is being fitted, a band at the top of the *Vehicle* tab names the job and the part and shows how far the job has got, in percent. *Install*, at the foot of the tab, is dimmed while the job runs.
The same job shows in the action bar over the car: the action, the part and the percent, with a bar that fills as the job goes on. Figure 6-2 shows both, a little over a third of the way through.
For work on a wheel, your character walks to the wheel first, then reaches for the tools the job needs.

blocks.note: With *Put things back after an action* on, the tools a job takes out of a bag go back to the same bag when the job is done, and what was in your hands goes back in your hands. Carry the jack and the wrench in a bag: tools left in the trunk are out of reach from the wheel.

caption: Figure 6-2
The band in the Vehicle tab, and the action bar over the car.

blocks.p: With the tire on, the wagon is ready for fuel. Chapter 10 shows how to refuel it.
